The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Athens County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 10 on Facebook or X for current Athens County construction information.

U.S. 33 Expansion (Athens and Meigs Counties)
A two-lane to four-lane expansion project is taking place on U.S. 33 from Athens to Darwin and Five Points to Ravenswood.

Between Oxley Rd. (Athens County) and Rocksprings Rd. (Meigs County), the shoulders are closed and side roads are closed intermittently for equipment crossing (through 2028)

Rolling road blocks will be in place when rock blasting is occurring

Through June 1, 2027, the passing lane is closed in both directions on U.S. 33 between Oxley Rd. and Pleasant Hill Rd.

Pleasanton Road is closed through November 20, 2026. ODOT's detour is Old U.S. 33 to Pleasant Hill Rd. 

At Pleasanton Rd., a 13 ft. width restriction is in place on U.S. 33, and construction vehicles are periodically crossing both lanes of traffic. Temporary signals are maintaining traffic intermittently on U.S. 33 at Pleasanton Rd. (through November 20, 2026)

On the four-lane section between Pleasanton Road (Athens County) and Rocksprings Road (Meigs County), lane closures are in place in both directions (through December 31, 2026)

Read more about the U.S. 33 Expansion project

Overall Project Completion: 2028

U.S. 33 Resurfacing (Athens and Hocking Counties)
A resurfacing project is taking place on U.S. 33 from Nelsonville to Logan. Lane closures are in place on U.S. 33
Estimated Completion: November 7

U.S. 33 Sign Replacements
A sign replacement project is taking place on U.S. 33 between SR 682 and Rock Riffle Road. There will be intermittent shoulder closures.
Estimated Completion: November 30

State Route 13 Rockfall Hazard Mitigation
A rockfall hazard mitigation project begins on November 9 on SR 13 between Red Rock Road and SR 78. Traffic will be maintained with temporary signals. Traffic will be stopped for up to 15 minutes during rock blasting operations.
Estimated Completion: June 1, 2027

Nelsonville Pedestrian Safety Project
A pedestrian safety project is taking place in the City of Nelsonville. Locations include Fayette Street, Jefferson Street, Watkins Street, and Chestnut Street. There will be periodic sidewalk and parking closures, typically one or two blocks at a time.
Estimated Completion: November 27

The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Belmont County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 11 on Facebook or X for current Belmont County construction information. 

Interstate 70 Projects

I-70/State Route 149 interchange improvement: Work is underway on the major interchange improvement project at the I-70 Exit 208 for SR 149/Morristown. I-70 currently has two lanes open in both directions. Future traffic impacts for SR 149 will begin in 2027. For project details and all traffic impacts, visit the project webpage. Estimated Completion: 2029

U.S. Route and State Route Projects

Currently, there are no active U.S. or State Route projects in Belmont County.

The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Carroll County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 11 on Facebook or X for current Carroll County construction information.

Grant Street Boulevard closure in Minerva: Grant Boulevard is closed between South Market Street and Murray Avenue to replace the Sandy Creek bridge. Estimated completion: November 30, 2026.

The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Columbiana County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 11 on Facebook or X for current Columbiana County construction information. 

State Route Projects

Resurfacing in Lisbon: Resurfacing sections of SR 45 and SR 164 in Lisbon. Traffic is maintained with flaggers. Estimated Completion: November 30, 2026

Resurfacing in Salem: Resurfacing sections of SR 14 and SR 9 in Salem. Traffic is maintained with flaggers. Estimated Completion: November 30, 2026

The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Coshocton County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 5 on Facebook or Twitter for current Coshocton County construction information.

U.S. and State Route Projects

State Route 93 will experience daytime lane closures between U.S. Route 36 and the Holmes County line for paving operations. Both directions of travel will be maintained by flaggers. Estimated project completion: Fall 2027.

The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Guernsey County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 5 on Facebook or Twitter for current Guernsey County construction information.

Interstate 77

Interstate 77 Bridge Preservation – This project will repair the existing large diameter culvert under I-77 to extend its service life. Estimated project completion: December 2026.

Continued Impacts: 

Old Twenty-One Road (CR 35) is closed to traffic.

The following traffic advisory includes restrictions on the state highway system in Hamilton County. All work will be contingent upon the weather. For construction information and statewide information regarding road conditions, visit ODOT on the web at www.Ohgo.com.


Interstate Projects

I-75/Brent Spence Bridge Corridor - Construction of a new double-decker companion bridge adjacent to the existing Brent Spence Bridge to carry interstate and thru traffic. Project also includes improvements of approximately one mile of roadway, between the bridge approach and Linn Street, as well as a redesign and improvements to ramp configurations. Estimated Completion: 2031 (new companion bridge) and 2033 (approach work)

New Impacts

Friday, November 6 and Sunday, November 8:

Single-lane (left lane) closure on the ramp from I-75 North to U.S. 50 West, from 8 p.m. Friday to 8 a.m. Saturday and 8 p.m. Sunday to 6 a.m. Monday.

Traffic on the ramp will be merged into the ramp from I-71/Fort Washington Way, and the restriction will extend to the Gest Street overpass.


Continuing Impacts

W. Pete Rose Way/Longworth Hall Building Demolition - Intermittent single-lane closure, as well as full closure on Pete Rose Way, between Smith Street/Clay Wade Bailey Bridge and Gas Alley, for ongoing building demolition. During daytime hours of operation, weekdays from approximately 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., single-lane or full closures will be in effect. Traffic will be maintained as needed by flaggers or, during periods of closure, motorists will be detoured by way of Central Avenue and Mehring Way. Estimated Completion: November 2026.

Second Street Ramp Demolition - Second Street is reduced to one, 10-foot lane between the Clay Wade Bailey Bridge and Elm Street for entrance ramp (bridge) demolition. Traffic will be maintained in one, 10-foot lane through the spring of 2027.

---

I-75/Linn Street Bridge Replacement & Reconstruction - Over I-75, between W. Court Street and W. 8th Street. Linn Street is closed between W. 8th and W. Court streets through the fall of 2027 for replacement and reconstruction. Northbound motorists will be detoured via W. 8th Street, Freeman Avenue and Ezzard Charles Drive. Southbound motorists will be rerouted by way of Ezzard Charles Drive, Western Avenue, Freeman and W. 8th.

New Impact

Thursday, November 12:

Single-lane (right lane) closure on I-75 North, between Sixth Street and the Linn Street overpass, from 8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Friday.

Traffic will be maintained through the work zone; however, motorists are reminded of the need for additional caution when traveling through the area and to pay attention to merging traffic.

Continuing Impacts

W. Court Street Storm/Sanitary Sewer Line & Pavement Construction - W. Court Street is reduced to one lane between Linn Street and its end near 898 W. Court. Traffic will be maintained with temporary signals, and the restriction is scheduled to be in effect through early November 2026.


Gest Street Water Line/Reconstruction - Gest Street is closed between Freeman Avenue and 7th Street for water line replacement as part of the Brent Spence Bridge Corridor (Phase 3) project, as well as for reconstruction as part of the Linn Street bridge replacement. The closure will be in effect through June 2030, and westbound motorists will detour via Linn Street, 8th Street and Freeman Avenue; eastbound motorists are being detoured via Freeman and 8th Street.
 

Winchell Avenue Reconstruction - The ramp to Winchell Avenue/Ezzard Charles Drive from I-75 North, 9th Street and 6th Street is closed through May 2027 as part of the upcoming Linn Street bridge replacement/reconstruction project. There will be no signed detour for Winchell Avenue. Motorists from 9th Street to I-75 North will be detoured via 8th Street and Freeman Avenue to I-75. Access from 6th Street to Winchell will be closed with a right-lane closure on the ramp.
 

Western Avenue Entrance Ramp Replacement - The ramp from Western Avenue to I-75 South has been closed to accommodate the maintenance of traffic plan during the Linn Street bridge replacement. This is a permanent closure, and a new ramp from Freeman Avenue to southbound I-75 will be built as part of future construction for the Brent Spence Bridge Corridor.

---


Mill Creek Expressway - Phase 8 (Railroad Bridge Reconstruction) - As part of the Mill Creek Expressway - Phase 8 project, construction includes replacement of three railroad bridges located over Prosser Avenue, I-75, and SR 562, as well as minor realignment of I-75 lanes to accommodate new railroad bridge pier location on I-75. Lane shifts are in effect in both directions, as well as a contraflow lane for southbound traffic. Additional lane and ramp restrictions will be in effect throughout the project. Estimated Completion: Summer 2027

Mill Creek Expressway - Phase 8B (Pump Station & CSO) - Phase 8B is the construction of a new Pump Station and Combined Sewer Overflow for the widening of I-75. Construction is being conducted off the roadway, so there should be little to no impact to traffic associated with this project. Estimated Completion: Fall 2028

Mill Creek Expressway - Phase 8C (Widening) - Phase 8C extends from Regina Graeter Way to the Galbraith Road/SR 126/RRCC interchange area and includes widening I-75 for additional through lanes and rehabilitating bridges. Traffic on I-75 North and South is being maintained in three lanes in each direction, but traffic has been shifted to the east, and a contraflow lane has been implemented on southbound I-75. Various lane and ramp restrictions will be in effect during the evening and overnight hours. Estimated Completion: Fall 2027

Continuing Impact

Summit Road is closed between Paddock Road and Woodland Avenue, adjacent to northbound I-75, for the widening project and construction of a pedestrian bridge at Section Road. The closure will be in effect through the summer of 2028, and motorists will be detoured by way of Seymour Avenue and Reading Road. 

---

I-75 Bridge Rehabilitation - On northbound I-75 over Mill Creek, Benson Street and Shepherd Lane. In addition to rehabilitating the bridge, the project includes resurfacing I-75 North and South through the Lockland Split. I-75 traffic will be maintained with evening and overnight lane restrictions as work is scheduled. Estimated Completion: November 2026

---

I-71/Woodburn Avenue Bridge Rehabilitation - Minor rehabilitation project on the Woodburn Avenue bridge over I-71. Traffic on Woodburn Avenue will be maintained in a minimum of one lane in each direction; traffic on I-71 will be maintained with various shoulder and lane restrictions in effect during evening and overnight hours. Estimated Completion: October 2026


---

I-74/I-275 Overlap Resurfacing - From just west of the S.R. 128 interchange to the Harrison Avenue interchange. Single and double-lane closures may be in effect nightly from 7 p.m. to 7 a.m. for various phases of construction, with traffic maintained in a minimum of one, 12-foot lane in either direction. Estimated Completion: November 2026

I-74 Cable Barrier Installation - Between the Indiana state line and I-275. Traffic will be maintained in a minimum of one, 12-foot lane in either direction. Estimated Completion: November 2026

---

I-275/S.R. 4 Bridge Repair - At the bridge on I-275 over S.R. 4 (Springdale Pike). Intermittent lane restrictions and ramp closures will be in effect on S.R. 4, as well as on I-275, at the overpass. Traffic on S.R. 4 and I-275 will be maintained. Estimated Completion: November 2026

I-275 Resurfacing - Between the U.S. 42/Lebanon Road and I-75 interchanges. During paving operations, traffic on I-275 will be maintained with evening and overnight lane closures, from approximately 8 p.m. to 6 a.m. the following day. Estimated Completion: November 2026

I-275 Resurfacing - Between the U.S. 52 interchange and the Asbury Road overpass, west of the Five Mile Road interchange. Throughout the project, traffic on I-275 will be maintained with evening and overnight lane closures. Estimated Completion: November 2026


I-275 Bridge Maintenance - Sealing concrete at various structures on the I-275 corridor. Intermittent lane restrictions will be in effect during evening and overnight hours as crews are scheduled. Estimated completion: October 2027

---


U.S. and State Route Projects


CONTINUING IMPACTS


S.R. 126/Ronald Reagan Cross County Highway Resurfacing - Between the Colerain Avenue and W. Galbraith Road interchanges. Traffic will be maintained in a minimum of one lane in either direction throughout construction. Estimated Completion: November 2026

S.R. 126/Ronald Reagan Cross County Highway Bridge Painting - At various structures between I-75 and Plainfield Road. Traffic will be maintained in a minimum of one lane in either direction throughout construction. Intermittent overnight ramp closures will be in effect. Estimated Completion: July 2027

S.R. 128 Resurfacing - Between U.S. 50 at Cleves and Harrison Avenue. Single-lane closures will be in effect daily, from 8:30 a.m. to 3 p.m. and from 7 p.m. to 6:30 a.m. the following day. Traffic will be maintained by flaggers and/or other traffic control devices during hours of operation. Estimated Completion: November 2026

S.R. 264 (Glenway Avenue) Roadway Reconstruction - Between Nova Avenue and the intersection with Crookshank Road/Boudinot Avenue. Traffic will be shifted and maintained in a minimum of one, 11-foot lane in either direction with flaggers and/or traffic control devices. Estimated Completion: November 2026

U.S. 22 (Gilbert Avenue) & I-71 Pedestrian Bridge Replacement - Construction of a new pedestrian facility connecting Mt. Adams and Cincinnati by replacing the pedestrian bridges over I-71/471 and Gilbert Avenue with the construction of a single, shared-use path bridge over the interstate and Gilbert. Throughout most of the project, the structure over I-71/471 will remain open to pedestrians, and intermittent vehicular and pedestrian traffic restrictions will be in effect. Estimated Completion: December 2026

U.S. 50/Columbia Connector Shared Use Path - From Pocahontas Avenue at Mariemont to the existing Little Miami Scenic Trail, east of Walton Creek Road. Traffic on U.S. 50 (Wooster Pike) will be maintained in one, 11-foot lane in the westbound direction between Warrior Way and Spring Hill Drive. Additional restrictions will be in place on Wooster Pike, as well as on Miami Run, Mariemont Way and Warrior Way; however, traffic will be maintained throughout construction. Estimated Completion: November 2027

U.S. 52 Joint/Pavement Repairs - From the I-275 interchange to Beckjord Road in Clermont County. Traffic will be maintained in a minimum of one, 11-foot lane in each direction during daytime workings hours, from approximately 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Estimated Completion: November 2026

---


Local Road Projects


Continuing Impacts

Glenwood Gardens Trail & Shared-Use Path - Construction of a shared use trail connecting the Winton Woods Park trail network to Carlsbad Road, Springfield Pike, and the West Fork Mill Creek Greenway at Glenwood Gardens Park. Work is being conducted off roadway, so there should be no impacts to motorists. Estimated Completion: October 2026

C.R. 14 (Dry Fork Road)/I-74 Bridge Replacement & Widening - A bridge replacement and widening project on Dry Fork Road over I-74 at Harrison. Dry Fork Road is closed through mid-December, and motorists are being detoured by way of West Road and Harrison Avenue. Traffic on I-74 will be maintained with periodic lane restrictions. Estimated Completion: June 2027

New Impact

Thursday, November 5:

Closure of the ramp from eastbound I-74 to Dry Fork Road, from 7 p.m. to 5 a.m. Friday for deck pour. Motorists may detour by way of the New Haven Road interchange and Harrison Avenue. 


C.R. 358/374 (Clough Pike and Newtown Road) Intersection Improvement - Construction of east and westbound left-turn lanes on Clough Pike at Newtown Road, as well as a sidewalk on the south side of Clough Pike, between Copperleaf Lane and Newtown Road. Traffic on Clough Pike will be maintained by flaggers during daytime hours of operation, daily from approximately 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. Southbound Newtown Road is closed between Mercers Point Drive and the junction with Clough Pike through early November (on or about November 8). Motorists will be detoured by way of Bartels Road and Clough Pike. Northbound Newtown Road is open to traffic. Estimated Completion: November 2026

The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Harrison County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 11 on Facebook or X for current Harrison County construction information. 

U.S. Route 22 Projects

U.S. Route 22 major pavement rehabilitation: A project to remove and replace nearly 4 miles of pavement along the four-lane section of U.S. Route 22, from the two-lane section west of Cadiz to just west of County Road 13 (Upper Clearfork Road). Currently, U.S. 22 is reduced to one lane in both directions, with traffic maintained in the eastbound lanes. Motorists are advised to slow down when approaching the construction zone and watch for signage. Ramp closures will occur throughout construction. Estimated Completion: Summer 2028

Associated active work zones with U.S. 22 major pavement rehabilitation project:

U.S. 22 eastbound EXIT ramp closure for Cadiz (U.S. 250/SR 9): The U.S. 22 eastbound EXIT ramp for Cadiz/U.S. 250 east/SR 9 north is closed. The closure is part of the ongoing U.S. 22 pavement rehabilitation project. The detour is to continue east on U.S. 22 to EXIT 224 (Jewett/Scio/SR 151 west), then take U.S. 22 west back to EXIT 220 (Cadiz/U.S. 250 east/SR 9 north). Estimated reopening date: December 20, 2026

State Route Projects

Currently, there are no active traffic impacts on State Routes in Harrison County.

The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Jefferson County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 11 on Facebook or X for current Jefferson County construction information. 

State Route 7 Projects

State Route 7 southbound 4th Street on-ramp closure near Toronto: The SR 7 southbound on-ramp from 4th Street in Toronto is closed to traffic as part of a mine subsidence restoration project. To access SR 7 southbound, traffic is rerouted northbound to the SR 152 exit, then returns to SR 7 southbound. Estimated Completion: November 20, 2026.

State Route 7 mine subsidence restoration: A mine subsidence restoration project on SR 7 just south of the 4th Street EXIT ramp in Toronto. One lane of traffic is maintained during construction. Estimated Completion: November 20, 2026

State Route 7 Northbound On-Ramp closure at Logan Avenue: The Logan Avenue ramp to SR 7 northbound is closed indefinitely due to a recurring slope failure. Since January 2025, the slope has repeatedly failed, prompting the ramp to be closed for safety until repairs can be made. Construction will begin in the coming months as ODOT awaits required approvals from the adjacent railroad. Estimated Completion: November 30, 2027

Other State Routes

State Route 152 closure north of Richmond: November 9-13: The first closure will be just south of the Edison Schools. During this closure, ODOT will accommodate all school traffic in the morning and afternoon. This closure will take place the week of Nov. 9. Work hours are 8 AM - 2:30 PM. November 16-20: After the first closure, crews will move to the next two locations north of CR 56/Edison Schools. Buses and emergency services will be accommodated during that closure. All other traffic must detour during the closure times. Work hours are 7:30 AM - 3 PM. The official detour is SR 43 south to U.S. 22 east, U.S. 22 east to SR 213 north, SR 213 north back to SR 152, and reverse. These dates are estimated and subject to change due to weather.

State Route 213 resurfacing: Resurface nearly nine miles of SR 213 from SR 7 in Steubenville to SR 152 in Knoxville. One lane of traffic is maintained with flaggers. Estimated Completion: November 30, 2026 

Local Projects

Reese Street bridge closure in Irondale: The Reese Street bridge, just south of Saline Street in Irondale, is closed for a bridge replacement. Estimated Completion: December 31, 2026

West Virginia DOT Traffic Impacts

Visit 511WV for traffic impacts in West Virginia. All information shared is provided by WVDOT. 

U.S. Route 22  Veterans Memorial Bridge nighttime closures: A portion of US 22, eastbound and westbound, on the Veterans Memorial Bridge, will have both the eastbound and westbound lanes closed on the following anticipated closure dates:

November 23rd, 8:00 PM - 5:00 AM

December 2nd, 8:00 PM - 5:00 AM

Closure 5: December 9th, 8:00 PM - 5:00 AM

Closure 6: December 15th, 8:00 PM - 5:00 AM

Closure 7: December 22nd, 8:00 PM - 5:00 AM

The closures are necessary to replace cable. The closures will be at night to minimize the impact on the traveling public. Motorists should follow detour signs and use an alternate route. Emergency vehicles will be accommodated.

Alternate Routes: Northbound traffic should use US 30 to East Liverpool, Ohio/Chester, WV, via the Jennings-Randolph Bridge, to WV 2 and Ohio 7. Southbound traffic should use Ohio 7 and WV 2 to Brilliant, Ohio, and Wellsburg, WV, onto the Wellsburg Bridge.

The following construction projects are anticipated to affect highways in Mahoning County next week. All scheduled work is weather permitting. 

---

Interstate 76/80 pavement rehabilitation, Austintown & Jackson Townships
CONTINUING IMPACT – I-80 east and west is reduced to two lanes between the Meander Reservoir and SR 46. Estimated completion, mid-November 2026.

---

Interstate 680 pavement replacement, Youngstown
CONTINUING IMPACT – I-680 southbound traffic is crossed over onto the northbound lanes through late November while I-680 southbound is reconstructed. 
CONTINUING IMPACT – I-680 northbound between South Ave. and SR 193 is CLOSED through summer 2027. The detour is U.S. 62 to U.S. 422 to SR 193.
CONTINUING IMPACT – The following ramps are closed through late November 2026:
• Sillman St to I-680 southbound. The detour is Steel St. to Mahoning Ave. to Belle Vista Ave. to Oakwood St. to I-680.
• SR 193 to I-680 southbound. The detour is I-680 northbound to SR 711 to U.S. 422 eastbound to U.S.62 west/SR 7 south to I-680 south.
• I-680 SB to Glenwood Ave./Mahoning Ave. The detour is I-680 southbound to South Ave. to Front St. to Marshall St.
• Glenwood Ave./Mahoning Ave to I-680 south. The detour is High St. to Oak Hill Rd. to Falls Ave. to Market St. to Williams Ave. to South Ave.
• I-680 south to Market St. south. The detour is I-680 south to South Ave. to Williamson Ave. to Market St.
• I-680 south to Market St. north. The detour is I-680 south to South Ave. to Williamson Ave. to Market St.
• I-680 south to U.S. 62/SR 7 north. The detour is I-680 south to South Ave. to U.S.62/SR 7.
CONTINUING IMPACT – The following ramps are closed through summer 2027:

• Marshall St. to I-680 north. The detour is Glenwood Ave. to Mahoning Ave. to Belle Vista Ave.
• I-680 north to Glenwood Ave./Mahoning Ave. The detour is South Ave. to Front St. to Marshall St.
• Market St. to I-680 north. The detour is Woodland Ave. to Hadnet Dr. to South Ave. to U.S. 62/SR 7 to U.S. 422 to SR 193.
• Woodland Ave. to I-680 north. The detour is Woodland Ave. to Hadnet Dr. to South Ave. to U.S. 62/SR 7 to U.S. 422 to SR 193. 
• U.S. 62 west/SR 7 south to I- 680 north. The detour is Woodland Ave. to Hadnet Dr. to South Ave. to U.S. 62/SR 7 to U.S. 422 to SR 193. 
Estimated completion, August 2028.

---

The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Meigs County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 10 on Facebook or X for current Meigs County construction information.

U.S. 33 Expansion (Athens and Meigs Counties)
A two-lane to four-lane expansion project is taking place on U.S. 33 from Athens to Darwin and Five Points to Ravenswood.

Barrels are in place on U.S. 33 between Five Points and the Ravenswood Bridge to delineate between the current road and road under construction (through 2028)

Barrier wall is in place through July 2027, creating a new traffic pattern on U.S. 33 west between SR 7 and Pine Grove Road

Through 2028, there will be intermittent flagging at SR 681 for equipment crossing

Through 2028, there will be intermittent closures of side roads between Pleasanton Rd. (Athens County) and Rocksprings Rd. (Meigs County) for equipment crossing

Read more about the project

Overall Project Completion: 2028

U.S. 33-SR 7-SR 124-SR 733-SR 833 Sign Replacements
A sign replacement project is taking place on U.S. 33, SR 7, SR 124, SR 733, and SR 833 at Rock Springs and Five Points. There are intermittent lane and shoulder closures in each direction.
Estimated Completion: November 30

State Route 681 Slope Stabilization
A slope stabilization project is taking place on SR 681 between Goose Creek Road and Carsey Road. Traffic is being maintained by flaggers.
Estimated Completion: November 2027

State Route 325 Culvert Replacement
A culvert repair project is taking place on SR 325 between Edmundson Road and Sanford Davis Road. Traffic is being maintained with temporary signals.
Estimated Completion: January 1, 2027

The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Monroe County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 10 on Facebook or X for current Monroe County construction information.

State Route 26 American Electric Power (AEP) Structure Maintenance
An American Electric Power (AEP) structure maintenance project is taking place on SR 26, between Jericho Low Gap Road and I.P. Hill Road. Traffic is being maintained with temporary signals.
Estimated Completion: November 30

Township Road 2214 Bridge Replacement
A bridge replacement project is taking place on Township Road 2214. The road is closed.  
Estimated Completion: November 30

Township Road 1004 Bridge Replacement
A bridge replacement project is taking place on Township Road 1004. The road is closed. 
From November 9-11 there will be delays on Mechanicsburg Road due to crane setup.
Estimated Completion: November 15

The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Muskingum County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 5 on Facebook or Twitter for current Muskingum County construction information.

Interstate 70

Reconstruction in Zanesville - This project will reconstruct I-70 though the city of Zanesville, resurface I-70 between U.S. 40 and State Route 93. Full reconstruction will begin west of the Licking Road overpass, including the Maple Avenue ramps and Maple Avenue at the end of the ramps, and end east of the abandoned railroad overpass. The project also impacts 16 bridges in the area. For more project details, visit the project page. Estimated Completion: Fall 2028.

Continued Impacts:

Lane closures are in place on Underwood Street for striping work.

Sixth Street under I-70 has reopened.

Phase three configuration is now in place. If the contractor must take a lane at overnight, the westbound driving lane will close, and the only access to downtown from I-70 westbound will be U.S. 40 (exit 152) and SR 93 (exit 157). 

I-70 westbound passing lane operates like an express lane. This means that once motorists enter the express lane after SR 93 (exit 157), they will be unable to exit until U.S. 40 (exit 152).

The I-70 westbound driving lane will be the only westbound lane with access to downtown Zanesville.

The Underwood Street eastbound on ramp is open to traffic. 

The State Street eastbound on ramp is open to traffic.

The Sixth Street westbound on ramp is closed to traffic.

The 7th Street eastbound off ramp is open to traffic.

The Underwood off-ramp is open to traffic. 

The Maple Avenue westbound off ramp is closed to traffic.

The Maple Avenue flyover ramp and the 6th Street on-ramp to I-70 westbound will remain closed during Phase three construction for safety reasons.

All work is weather dependent, and dates are subject to change. 

---

U.S. and State Route Projects 

State Route 340 will close to traffic between State Route 284 and Prouty Road beginning Wednesday, Nov. 11 for culvert work. The roadway is expected to reopen Wednesday, Nov. 25. Detour: SR 340 to SR 284 to SR 146 to SR 346 and reverse.

---

State Route 555 is closed to traffic between Pletcher Hill Road and Bush Hill Road. Estimated project completion: November 2026.  Detour: SR 555 to SR 669 to SR 93 to U.S. Route 22 to SR 719 to SR 555 and reverse. 

---

Motorist can expect lane closures on State Route 208 for full depth repair and resurfacing work between the Village of Adamsville and Dresden. Estimated project completion: November 2026.

---

Beginning Monday, Nov. 30, State Route 666 with close to traffic between Culbertson Road and Gilbert Road for culvert replacements, slope stabilization & utility relocation. The roadway is expected to reopen to traffic Friday, Jan. 15. Detour: SR 666 to SR 208 to SR 60 to SR 666 and reverse.

The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Noble County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 10 on Facebook or X for current Noble County construction information.

State Route 821 Landslide
Due to a landslide, traffic is being maintained with temporary signals on SR 821 between Baker Junkyard Road and  I-77. 
Estimated Completion: December 1

State Route 78 Bridge Replacement
A bridge replacement project is taking place on SR 78 between Cain Road and Collins Road. Traffic is being maintained with temporary signals. 
Estimated Completion: November 13

The following construction projects are anticipated to affect highways in Portage County next week. All scheduled work is weather permitting. 

---

State Route 14 & State Route 43 intersection improvements, Streetsboro
CONTINUING IMPACT – SR 303 at SR 14 is closed through late November. The detour is Superior Ave. to SR 14.  
Estimated completion, late November 2026.

---

The following construction projects are anticipated to affect highways in Stark County next week. All scheduled work is weather permitting.

---

Interstate 77 bridge joint repairs, Canton
NEW IMPACT – On Sunday evening, November 8, at 8 p.m., the following closures will be in place through Monday morning, November 9, at 5 a.m. for bridge joint repairs:
•	The ramp from U.S. 30 east to I-77 north. The detour will be U.S. 30 east to SR 43/Cherry St. to U.S. 30 west to I-77 north.
•	I-77 northbound at U.S. 30. The detour will be U.S. 30 east to SR 43/Cherry St. to U.S. 30 west to I-77 north.
